participation.context: Stood in the road. The picture is the gate, not a face.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You stood by the open gate. The picture is the hasp, the cap, and the backs.

title: Stood by the open Bedlam gate while backs ran north

description: A man who was not at the door

participation.context: Kept the hearsay as hearsay, and went on.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You told him what you had seen, and you refused the rest. You did not go to the Mayor's door. You went on toward the Theatre.
topics: a door you did not stand at

title: Told what you had seen and went on to the Theatre

participation.context: Spoke the three sentences and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You named the gate, the cap and the backs. You said you had not seen the middle. You stopped.

title: Named the open gate, the cap and the backs

participation.context: Reported only what he had seen, and refused a cause he did not have.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Said the man was a silkweaver, like himself, and English, and cut his bread smaller.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

participation.context: Kept the household at the table, and kept Verbeke under his own name.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Asked if the man was hurt, was told you did not know, and stopped at one gate.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

relations.note: he stays under his own name
relations.quote: You are in this house under your own name, at your own work, and you will sleep in your own bed.

story.body: You told them the gate, the hasp, the cap and the backs. You did not add a rescue. You let Verbeke keep the loom's sure part, and you stayed at the table.
